name: inspector-configuration-system
title: 完善页面与组件属性配置面板
description: Audit and complete Page and component Inspector properties with a reusable professional control system instead of raw form inputs.
scope: core page/component property contracts, renderer capability alignment, react-designer Inspector controls and Page/Single/Multi panels
creator: ROYIANS
notes: Measurement and page configuration are implemented, including instance-local mm/px switching, four-sided safe area, compatibility normalization, invalid-draft rejection and preserve-and-warn resizing. Page, Single and free-table business panels now compose a shared InspectorControls layer. ColorControl supports normalized HEX, transparent/reset actions, instance-local recent colors and derived document colors. Rich text uses canvas editing rather than an Inspector HTML source field. Component browser QA covers text, rich text, table, image, QR, barcode, line, rect, circle and star; full tests, typechecks, frontend lint and sequential package/Web builds pass. Multi/Group remain covered by Store tests and source contracts; responsive/mobile/200% and real-browser Multi/Group checks were not available in the current browser surface. The user explicitly requested commit and archive on 2026-07-30 and accepted the current verification evidence for task closure.
